content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the Zimbabwean dollar collapsed, and PayPal and Stripe were inaccessible, digital creators needed a new way to sell ebooks, templates, and digital products. This led to the development of a sovereign commerce infrastructure that enables creators to sell online without relying on traditional payment platforms. Today, COREMERCH provides a suite of tools and infrastructure components that allow creators to deploy their own digital product stores, using cryptocurrencies like TRON USDT for payment processing.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The infrastructure in question is a decentralized payment system, using TRON USDT as the primary cryptocurrency. This system allows digital creators to receive payments directly in cryptocurrency, bypassing traditional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe. The key benefit of this system is that it enables creators to maintain control over their payment processing, eliminating the need for intermediaries and associated fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The TRON USDT payment system is built on top of the TRON blockchain, which provides a fast and scalable platform for transactions. NOWPayments is used to integrate the TRON USDT payment gateway with the digital product store, enabling seamless payment processing. The system uses webhooks to notify the store of payment confirmations, ensuring that transactions are securely and automatically processed.

This infrastructure solution is designed for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products online. It is particularly suited for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable, such as Zimbabwe, Pakistan, or Bangladesh. The solution allows creators to deploy their own digital product stores, using cryptocurrencies like TRON USDT for payment processing.
TRON USDT payments bypass traditional payment platforms, eliminating intermediaries and associated fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer. This level of transparency and verifiability is structurally different from conventional payment processors, where transaction data is owned by the platform and subject to their record-keeping policies.

Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link before the test download link expires. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields. Publish your store URL and review your first week of orders in the database to confirm the automated pipeline is running correctly.
